newsitem.title: USA: Kinder Morgan names David Dehaemers CFO/vp.
newsitem.headline: Kinder Morgan names David Dehaemers CFO/vp.

text.p: Kinder Morgan Energy Partners LP and its general partner said Wednesday that David Dehaemers has been named vice-president and chief financial officer.
He succeeds Thomas Tosoni, who resigned to pursue other interests, said the company.

Dehaemers was elected secretary and treasurer of the general partner in February, 1997. Prior to that, he was chief financial officer of Morgan Associates Inc, an energy investment and pipeline management company.
Kinder Morgan owns and operates two interstate common carrier natural gas liquids pipeline systems and one carbon dioxide pipeline system.
